sources: IRGC navy statement via IRIB, carried by Al Jazeera liveblog 14:45 GMT (18:45 )
fault_line: Is the strait actually mined shut, or is Tehran staging mine claims to keep insurers and tankers out while CENTCOM insists the lanes are clear?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Iran's navy says an oil tanker struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz east of the waterway, causing damage and a fire on board and bringing the vessel to a halt. The navy said the tanker was navigating a 'prohibited and unsafe zone' east of the strait, and that 'the Strait of Hormuz is closed to offending vessels that attempt to traverse prohibited and unsafe areas without coordination, emboldened by the false claims of the US president.' Vessel unidentified; no casualty or flag information. DISTINCT from 1300-01 (3 tankers, southern route, past 24h): this is a fourth, eastern-strait incident claimed in-window. IMF PortWatch snapshot 2026-10-26 is STALE (lag 8 days): counted 4 transits through Hormuz on 2026-10-18, 7-day average 3.71 vs 2025 baseline 85.53/day. Cite only with observation date, never as a live figure.
sections.what_verified: Single origin: the claimant's own statement via IRIB (IRIB has NO declared tier in the registry - attribution only), carried by the AJ liveblog. No UKMTO or CENTCOM confirmation of this eastern-strait incident in-window; CENTCOM's Oct 28 mine-clearance denial stands as counterevidence. Passes via the primary-source single-family exception, stated explicitly.
sections.what_disputed: CENTCOM (Oct 28): US forces cleared the internationally recognised primary transit routes and those lanes remain free of mines. IRGC spokesman Mohebi (Oct 29) demands independent evidence for that claim. UKMTO's vessel-on-fire report (17 km north of Khasab) is a separate sighting with no verified link to any claimed tanker.
sections.why_matters: Fourth tanker in one day: Hormuz mine war, claim vs CENTCOM denial, counted transits still near zero on the stale Oct 18 count
sections.context: Background: NEW IN-WINDOW -- Iranian navy: FOURTH tanker hit a mine in eastern Hormuz, fire + halted; distinct from the morning's 3 southern-route tankers
